fbchateau.name: Château de Fontainebleau
fbchateau.slogan: Where kings hunted, and an emperor said goodbye.
fbchateau.line: The true residence of kings, the house of the centuries.

smvaux.name: Vaux-le-Vicomte
smvaux.slogan: The garden party that gave Louis XIV his Versailles.
smvaux.line: Fouquet bought and demolished three villages for it, and employed a reported 18,000 workers.

smdisney.name: Disneyland Park
smdisney.slogan: Sleeping Beauty's castle, an hour from the Eiffel Tower.
smdisney.line: It opened on 12 April 1992 as Euro Disney and drew almost eleven million guests in its first year.

pvcesar.name: Tour César, Provins
pvcesar.slogan: A count's keep above the old fair town.
pvcesar.line: Its 12th-century keep is an octagon rising from a square base, a rare design.

fbdenecourt.name: Tour Denecourt
fbdenecourt.slogan: Climb above the oaks and boulders of the forest.
fbdenecourt.line: Built in 1853 by Napoleonic veteran Claude-François Denecourt, who also marked the first blue hiking trails.
